content.short: Ormi is a next-generation data platform built for real-time and historical blockchain data at scale.
content.description: Ormi provides real-time, indexed blockchain data that's fresh, accurate, and ready to use in production. It stays aligned with the chain tip, automatically handling the full data lifecycle from syncing and indexing to serving, so you don't have to manage complex infrastructure. With Ormi you get reliable, up-to-date data you can trust for analytics, dashboards, and production workloads, without the burden of building and maintaining your own pipelines.
